caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular section of a textile pattern composed entirely of horizontal stripes of varying widths and colors. The stripes alternate between shades of olive green, beige, red, pink, orange, and brown. Some of the stripes have small, regularly spaced rectangular or dotted patterns within them, adding texture to the design. The colors are muted and earthy, with each stripe running parallel to the others from left to right across the textile. The entire textile section is set against a plain, off-white or cream background, with no other objects present in the image. In the lower right corner, there is a small inscription.
title: Handwoven Carpet
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
